REPORT
Date January 14, 1936.

Subject J. W. Ross, enquiry from Manufacturers' Life Insurance Co.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman. Forwarded by O B Ross D.I.

In compliance with the instructions of the Deputy
Commissioner (Special Branch) on the attached enquiry
I have to state that since April 1934, when he ceased
publication of his Anti-Nazi newspaper the "Shanghai
Anzieger", Ross has been engaged in the insurance business.
His newspaper was published for little over a fortnight
and when it closed down he owed the Comacrib Press about
$800. which has not been repaid. Until about a month
ago Ross, although not actually employed by the Crown
Life Insurance Co., was permitted by the firm to use their
offices and to assist one of their employees, a Miss Abraham,
in selling policies, Ross taking a share of the commissions
in the event of a successful deal. Owing, however, to
a disagreement with the manager, he was told that this
arrangement must be discontinued and that he was not, in
future, to use the Crown Life offices. Ross then sought
employment with the Manufacturers Life Insurance Co. and
was successful in obtaining a post which he still holds.
His present address is at House No. 1, Lane 1220,
Avenue Road.

D. P. S. Henchman
D. P. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1936年1月14日。

事由：J. W. Ross，来自宏利人寿保险公司（Manufacturers' Life Insurance Co.）的查询。

由副督察亨奇曼（D.P.S. Henchman）呈报。经督察罗斯（O B Ross D.I.）转呈。

遵照特科副总监在附函查询中的指示，本人谨陈述如下：自1934年4月罗斯停止出版其反纳粹报纸《上海通报》（Shanghai Anzieger）以来，他一直从事保险业务。他的报纸仅出版了两周多一点，停刊时他欠康纳克里布印刷所（Comacrib Press）约800美元，该笔款项至今未还。直到大约一个月前，罗斯虽未被皇冠人寿保险公司（Crown Life Insurance Co.）正式雇用，但该公司允许他使用其办公室，并协助该公司一名雇员亚伯拉罕小姐（Miss Abraham）推销保单，若交易成功，罗斯可分享佣金。然而，由于与经理发生分歧，他被告知必须终止此安排，且今后不得再使用皇冠人寿保险公司的办公室。随后，罗斯向宏利人寿保险公司求职，并成功获得了一个职位，目前仍在职。他现在的住址是爱文义路（Avenue Road）1220弄1号。

D. P. S. 亨奇曼
副督察

特科副总监

Date ____ August 22, 1934

Subject (in full) Dr. J.W. Ross; - alleged smuggling activities.

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by （签名） S.C.

On August 17, 1934 an Australian calling himself
Dr. J.W. Ross approached a certain person with the request that
he be placed in touch with somebody who could translate Greek
into English and vice-versa, as he (Ross) was making enquiries
on behalf of the Shanghai Municipal Police into the activities
of an international gang of narcotic smugglers.

The following information has been secured
regarding Ross :-

A native of Richmond (N.S.W.) he was born about
34 years ago. He obtained a medical degree (M.D.) in Johannes-
burg, S.A., and from January 1, 1923 until November 17, 1926
acted as private secretary to D.S. Davidson, General Manager
of H.E. Babb & Co. Ltd., Carlton House, Eloff St., Johannesburg.

From August 1, 1931 until April, 1933 Ross acted
in a secretarial capacity to the Minister of the Court to H.I.H.
Shah Reza Khan I of Persia, but his engagement was broken off
with the incidence of political troubles in Persia when the
Minister of the Court was arrested.

He arrived in Shanghai in August 1933 and from
November of that year until March 1934 was employed with
"Shanghai Deutscher Zeitung," Simon Eberhardt's daily German
newspaper.

He had some trouble with Eberhardt and left to
commence business on his own but soon failed.

Ross says he can speak and write English, French,
German, Spanish, Portuguese and Persian fluently, that he is an
accomplished accountant, stenographer and aviator, and in
addition is a qualified medical practitioner.

He is an extremely well-dressed individual and

日期：1934年8月22日

完整事由：J.W. 罗斯博士；涉嫌走私活动。

由警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts）呈报。经（签名）S.C. 转呈。

1934年8月17日，一名自称J.W. 罗斯博士的澳大利亚人接触某人士，请求为其联系一位能将希腊语译成英语、反之亦然的人员，因为他（罗斯）正代表上海公共租界工部局警务处调查一个国际毒品走私团伙的活动。

关于罗斯，已获取如下信息：

他是新南威尔士州里士满（Richmond, N.S.W.）人，现年约34岁。他在南非约翰内斯堡获得医学博士学位（M.D.），并于1923年1月1日至1926年11月17日期间，担任H.E. Babb & Co. Ltd.（地址：约翰内斯堡埃洛夫街卡尔顿大楼）总经理D.S. 戴维森的私人秘书。

从1931年8月1日至1933年4月，罗斯担任波斯国王礼萨汗陛下宫廷大臣的秘书，但随着波斯发生政治动荡及宫廷大臣被捕，他的聘约随之终止。

他于1933年8月抵达上海，并从同年11月至1934年3月受雇于西蒙·埃伯哈特（Simon Eberhardt）主办的德文日报《上海德文报》（Shanghai Deutscher Zeitung）。

他与埃伯哈特发生了一些纠纷，遂离职自行经商，但很快失败。

罗斯声称他能流利地说写英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和波斯语，是一位精通会计、速记和飞行技术的人士，此外还拥有行医资格。

他衣着极其讲究，且
